data.narrative:
Biofire is a Series A-stage defense and security company founded by Kai Kloepfer that has raised $52.9M to date. Valuation assessment draws on a comp universe of 10 private and 2 public peers in the Defense & Security sector, including Stark Defence, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression approach uses the $53M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage advancement, implying a valuation of $106M. The peer-median method references three same-sector, same-stage comparables—Stark Defence at $4.0B, Singularity at $400M, and NODA AI at $125M—yielding a median of $400M, though this range ($125M–$4.0B) reflects material dispersion within the peer set.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $90M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $253M. The stage-progression method anchors the lower bound, while peer-median valuation drives the higher estimate. The substantial gap between methods reflects uncertainty inherent in comparables selection within a fragmented and volatile defense-tech sector, where valuations vary widely by investor appetite, technical differentiation, and government contracting exposure. Resolution of this range would benefit from deeper diligence on Biofire's IP position, revenue traction, and strategic customer commitments relative to the peer set.
